title: User A cannot change User B's data
shows: Edits, deletes and cross-User references with B's IDs are refused, and B's rows are unchanged afterwards.
limits: Covers transactions and accounts; other resource types follow the same repository pattern but are not all exercised.

screenshots.caption: B's own History afterwards: B Private Clinic, Rp 987.000, intact
